BiblicalUsage: The sneezing of Leviathan gives off light, and this is the word for that sneeze. It appears only here, in God's description of the creature no man can tame.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is meant to humble us: even Leviathan's sneeze shines, and the God who made him is beyond our measuring.
